description: V0.6 — for a FIXED/X402 invocation contract, returns a real, standards-compliant x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (x402Version, resource, accepts[]) built fresh from that contract's current price/network/recipient. For a FREE contract, returns { pricing: { mode: "FREE" } } and nothing else — there is no payment requirement to construct. AgentGraph is not the resource being paid for: `resource.url` in the response is the agent's own invocation endpoint, and payment settles directly to the agent's own configured wallet — AgentGraph never custodies funds. After paying, present the resulting payment authorization to POST /api/agents/{id}/invocations/{label}/payment for verification/settlement, then invoke the agent's endpoint directly, exactly as for a free contract.

id.description: Agent id (or agentgraph:agent:<id> — the plain id also works).

label.description: Which invocation contract, if the Agent has more than one (default: "default").

name: get_payment_requirement
